You came from my page, so I'll keep it short. Platinum records, built by myself, a #1 on Billboard, cuts with the biggest names in the industry, sync placements with the biggest companies in the world, records charting internationally. The point isn't the list. Every one of those came from the same rooms and the same pipeline you plug into the second you're in. All self-taught from a bedroom in Australia, so this works from anywhere, with or without a name.

Most producers have no way to get their music in front of artists. They flip the same recycled packs and wait. No pipeline, no briefs, no relationships. Just uploads to platforms that never answer. The producers landing placements have one thing the rest don't: a direct line to where the decisions get made. That line is the whole game, and it's what you're stepping into.
This isn't a promise or a waitlist. The portal's built and live. The night you join you get your login and you're on that night's briefs.

100+ active artist briefs, updated every single day, filterable by status and genre. 5 to 10 packs go direct to artist phone numbers every night. Not email, not a submission form. Their phone. You're on the same briefs I am, and the ones that fit ride that night's send.
See how the status system works

Urgent: closing this week, send now. Hot: packs actively going, high chance of landing. Warm: early conversations. Cold: on the radar for later. Each brief tells you what the artist needs, reference tracks to match, BPM and key where it exists.

3,000+ stems and samples through the Untitled app, not a dead download link. Get notified the second new sounds land, then drag, drop and export straight into your session. New sounds daily means first mover advantage on every fresh brief.

The OCTAVES Creator Suite (7 kits plus my mix and master chains), the unreleased Pt 2, Analog Alchemy, 2,100+ files all analog-recorded and royalty free, plus vaulted kits pulled from sale and every kit I make from here on. Then a members-only kit every month, 30 to 50 curated files, never public.

40GB+ of video breakdowns, plus 34 written guides, around 200 pages on top of the videos. Placements, networking, sales, and the business side nobody teaches. The exact system that took me from a bedroom to platinum.

Building a portfolio that works for itself, outreach that doesn't read as spam, collaborating so your sends multiply through other networks, targeting emerging artists in the 1K to 100K range, going global, and the business side: contracts, publishing, royalties, PROs, negotiating. Plus 40GB+ of accelerator and mentorship videos.
Submit your beats and watch the status move: New, In Review, Sent to Artist, Placed. I listen to everything personally and DM you the second it moves. You always know exactly where your music sits.
A direct line to me whenever you need it. A brief, a placement, mixing notes, anything, sent straight to me and reviewed personally. This is the access people don't believe until they're inside.
It all lives in one members portal. One login, everything in it, updating forever.
Day one you have the full archive, every kit, the accelerator, the submission system, and the live pipeline. Nothing held back.
Upload your heat and tag the vibe and genre. I get notified the moment it lands.
I listen and match your beats to the active briefs. If it fits, it's tagged for the next nightly send.
THE RIGHT ONES HIT ARTIST PHONES.
When your beat fits a brief it rides that night's send, straight to artist phone numbers. Not a playlist, not a form. A text.
When a record connects your status moves to Placed and you hear it from me. Credit and splits agreed before anything releases. Your rights stay yours, always.

Fair question, you should be asking it. The portal's built and live, not a promise. Want to see it first, DM me and I'll walk you through everything before you pay a dollar. Either way you're set up within the hour. The risk is on me, not you.
Do you place my beats for me?
No, and run from anyone who says they will. What you get is access. You send on the exact same briefs I run my own career off. The door's open, your music walks through it. We want hits not beats.
I'm not landing placements yet. Am I good enough?

Everyone in there started in a bedroom with nothing. You don't get good then join, you join and get good. The sounds level you up instantly, the mentorship shows you how, being around it daily does the rest.
That's exactly why it fits. The part that eats your time, finding opps and chasing contacts and digging for sounds, is done for you and handed over daily. You just make music and send.
What happens to beats that don't place?
They stay yours. Sell them, lease them, put them on BeatStars. Placed records get proper credit and splits, agreed clearly before anything releases.
How do I pay and get in?
Hit Get Lifetime Access and check out. You're in the moment it clears, working that night's briefs. Want to see inside first, DM me "IN" on IG @elxyee.
Forever. New samples daily, a new kit monthly, new briefs every day, plus every kit and guide I make for the rest of my career. As I climb, you climb.
